title: Route response-time sparkview: percentile swimlanes + streaming split
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a new Grafana-style dashboard ("Sparkview") that surfaces per-route and per-model response-time distributions as swimlane/heatmap views focused on p50/p95/p99 plus a clear split between streaming and non-streaming IO modes. The goal is a fast investigative UX for SREs and engineers to identify regression cohort(s) quickly, jump to traces/logs, and understand correlations with request shape and KV-cache status.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 tiles per route and model for last 1h/6h/24h windows
Swimlane heatmap visualizes percentile drift across time slices and request-shape cohorts
Toggle to compare Streaming vs Non-streaming (IO mode) updates all panels and cohort filters
Each cell links to a sample trace and related logs (trace link + log query prefilled)
Percentile overlay supports SLO threshold lines and on-click drilldown to request shape distribution
Queries run within configured thresholds (< 2s median panel refresh for 6h window) and respect RBAC
implementation_notes: Instrumentation: add span attributes serve.route, model.name, io.mode (streaming|blocking), request.shape (short|medium|long), kv_cache_state (warm|cold) to traces. Metrics: publish per-request latency histogram buckets to Prometheus/Pushgateway and aggregated summaries to ClickHouse for high-cardinality breakdowns. Logs: ensure request_id and trace_id are present and formatted consistently for Loki linking. Storage: use ClickHouse for high-cardinality percentile queries and Grafana heatmap plugin for swimlanes. Trace linking: generate Tempo/Jaeger URL templates from trace_id and include them in cell actions. Sampling: bias tail sampler to retain 2% of requests globally but 20% for p99 bucket samples. Query snippets: PromQL for metrics summary, ClickHouse SQL for percentile by model+route+io.mode. Performance: pre-aggregate percentiles hourly for long-range views to keep dashboard responsive.
